description: Find current official free tiers, application-based credits and relay free groups. Return the stated benefit, six requirements, deadline, original observation and claim link. userCanMeet=no_card excludes explicit required/conditional card entries; unknown card requirements remain clearly labelled unknown. Application categories describe programs, not the user’s eligibility. Follow pagination.

asOf.description: Evaluate as of this UTC time (ISO 8601, e.g. "2026-10-16T12:00:00Z"). Omit to evaluate now.

host.description: The assistant or app making this call, e.g. "claude-code" or "codex". Attribution only; it does not change results.

kind.description: "official" free tiers and credits, "relay" free groups, or "all".

q.description: Model, vendor or site to search, e.g. "gemini".

releaseSet.description: Pin a published data release by its release-set hash. Omit to use the current release.

skillBuild.description: Grandet Skill build ID when called from the Skill. Omit otherwise.

skillVersion.description: Grandet Skill version when called from the Skill, e.g. "0.3.0". Omit otherwise.

targetApp.description: Catalogue ID of the app that will use the API, e.g. "openclaw", "claude-code" or "codex". Selects compatible protocols and connection steps. Send it only when the user says where the API will be used.

userCanMeet.description: Only offers the user can meet: "any", "no_card" (no payment card) or "student".

view.description: "compact" (default): about 18 KB for a typical query. "full": every field, often over 250 KB.

name: grandet_find_free_credits
title: Find free API credit / 查找免费 API 额度
